signals.label: Installed 0.1.20 cumulative acceptance
signals.scope: Exact 0.1.20+1.21.1 installed acceptance ended as a partial PASS, not a full release acceptance. Text, STT, Chat, TTS, Voice Chat, Operator Lore scopes, restart, rollback-world loading and most synchronized gameplay scenarios passed. Release defects remained: an NPC became trapped in water and drowned; a filled grave broken with Silk Touch disappeared without an item; embedded identity reported a snapshot; and one Chat request took approximately 272 seconds.

signals.label: Installed 0.1.21 startup blocker and safe rollback
signals.scope: Exact 0.1.21+1.21.1 failed during startup before world and gameplay acceptance because MixinTombstoneBlock could not resolve the production getDrops target. The operator rolled back to 0.1.20; six persistent file hashes matched, the server reached STARTED, TCP 25565, UDP 24454, Voice Chat and monitoring recovered. This failure remains historical negative evidence and is not erased by later automated correction.

Exact-head repository, Fabric/NeoForge, remapped-package, security and applicable supply-chain gates passed.

signals.label: M11 Phase B production-JAR acceptance PR #104
signals.scope: PR #104 installed the exact remapped Fabric candidate into an isolated production server outside the Loom development classpath. The candidate reached the ready marker in two separate JVM runs, stopped cleanly, saved the world and exited with code 0. memory.json, memory2.json, semantic-memory.json, relationships.json, voices.json and operator-lore.json retained identical relative paths and SHA-256 values across restart. Test fixture code was excluded from the distributable JAR. This automated proof does not complete real-provider Text/STT/Chat/TTS, two-client, focused live water/grave or product-owner cumulative acceptance.
